evals.prompt: Set up the Mimas agent instruction file tree for the repository at /tmp/test-repos/fastapi-python.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md at root, full docs/ hierarchy, and src/CONTEXT.md — all tailored to FastAPI/Python/SQLAlchemy/Alembic/pytest/mypy/OpenAI stack with GitHub platform

assertions.description: Skill presents discovered stack/platform/subdomains and asks the user to confirm before generating files
assertions.check: Agent output shows a findings summary (stack, platform, subdomains) and asks for confirmation or corrections before generating any files

assertions.description: CLAUDE.md is created at root and points to AGENTS.md
assertions.check: CLAUDE.md exists and contains a reference to AGENTS.md

assertions.description: All 7 required instruction files are created
assertions.check: Files exist: AGENTS.md, docs/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md, docs/ENGINEERING.md, docs/AGENTS_FEATURES.md, docs/FEATURES.md, docs/features/feature-template.md, src/CONTEXT.md

assertions.description: Generated files mention the actual tech stack by name (FastAPI, pytest, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, mypy)
assertions.check: AGENTS.md and ENGINEERING.md collectively contain: 'FastAPI', 'pytest', 'mypy', and at least one of 'SQLAlchemy'/'Alembic'

assertions.description: Root AGENTS.md contains the TDD mandatory rule with red-green-refactor
assertions.check: AGENTS.md contains 'MANDATORY' and mentions RED/failing tests as part of TDD

assertions.description: Root AGENTS.md contains a mypy type checking mandatory rule
assertions.check: AGENTS.md contains 'mypy' in a critical/mandatory rule section

assertions.description: ENGINEERING.md commands section has correct pytest and mypy commands
assertions.check: ENGINEERING.md contains 'pytest' as the test command and 'mypy' as the typecheck command

assertions.description: Files do not contain references to wrong tech stacks (TypeScript, Jest, npm, tsc)
assertions.check: AGENTS.md and ENGINEERING.md do NOT contain 'TypeScript', 'Jest', 'npm test', or 'tsc --noEmit'

assertions.description: src/CONTEXT.md mentions FastAPI-relevant focus areas (endpoints, Pydantic, etc.)
assertions.check: src/CONTEXT.md mentions at least 2 of: endpoints/routes, Pydantic/validation/schemas, database/SQLAlchemy, OpenAI/AI

assertions.description: docs/features/feature-template.md is a template, not filled in with project specifics
assertions.check: docs/features/feature-template.md contains '[Feature Name]' or placeholder brackets — it is a template, not a completed doc

assertions.description: No starter skills are scaffolded — the skill points users to the Mimas repo instead
assertions.check: The .claude/skills/ directory does not exist or is empty; agent output references https://github.com/Grade-AI-Labs/Mimas for installable skills

assertions.description: GitHub platform is detected from git remote and reflected in generated files
assertions.check: docs/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md or docs/ENGINEERING.md contains references to GitHub, PRs, or gh CLI commands
